newsitem.title: USA: Father's Florida standoff ends with murder charge.
newsitem.headline: Father's Florida standoff ends with murder charge.

text.p: A Florida man was charged with murder Friday after allegedly killing his 5-week-old son's teenage uncle and then holding police at bay for 17 hours with a gun pointed at the baby's head.

Volusia County Judge Pope Hammerick ordered Ronell Davon Baker, 23, held without bail on charges of first-degree felony murder and armed burglary in his first court appearance after his overnight standoff with police.
Burglary is defined as breaking into an occupied residence to commit theft or another felony.
The standoff began Wednesday evening after Baker went to the apartment of his 16-year-old girlfriend, Colanna Taylor, to argue over visits to his 5-week-old son, Emundri Taylor.
Police said Baker shot the baby's teenage uncle, Germaine Taylor, once in the chest, killing him, when Baker snatched the baby from the apartment.

That led to an all-night standoff as Baker wandered freely through a section of the centre of this northeastern Florida city, which was cordoned off by police. SWAT teams stood by but did not move against Baker, because he was armed with a .32-calibre pistol aimed at the child's head.
Baker returned to the Taylor apartment about dawn and remained there until surrendering peacefully shortly after noon Thursday.
A spokesman for the Florida State Attorney's Office said the charges filed against him were related only to the shooting death and other charges could be added later.
